one_line_definition: RAG lets an AI look up relevant documents and use them to answer, instead of relying only on what it memorised in training.
why_it_matters: Answers become current, grounded in your own documents, and can cite sources.
pain_point: Chatbots confidently give outdated or made-up answers.
how_it_works: Search a vector database for similar text

key_facts.fact: RAG was introduced by Lewis et al. in 2020.

analogies: A librarian who checks the shelves before answering
